newsitem.title: GERMANY: Adidas shares slip on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Adidas shares slip on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares in German sportswear manufacturer Adidas AG were lower in bourse trade on Wednesday, hurt by profit-taking after the recent run-up to a record high.
Adidas shares were down three marks at 135.50 marks but off the session low so far at 133.00 marks.

Traders said Adidas shares, which hit a new record high at 140 marks this week, were under pressure from moderate selling as the losses outpaced the 30-share DAX index, which was steady at 2,628.10 points.
A firmer dollar and strong orders following heavy advertising at the European Championship for soccer and the Altanta Olympics helped propel the stock to record levels.
